papers.title_en: MPQ: A Message-Passing View of Post-Training Quantization
papers.authors: Yanshuo Chen, Chenxi Liu, Reza Shirkavand, Heng Huang
papers.evidence: 将GPTQ等LLM训练后量化求解器重构为码本消息传递
papers.tldr: 训练后量化（PTQ）能把大模型权重压到低比特而无需重训，但现有求解器（GPTQ、LDLQ、块坐标下降等）在未考虑相邻块时就对每个权重块做硬判决，提前锁定单一码字、丢弃近优解。MPQ 把逐行 PTQ 建模为离散码本上的后验推断，用向量近似消息传递保留跨块的软后验，仅在输出阶段才提交硬码字。在 Llama、Qwen、Mistral 上做 2 比特格点与 3/4 比特标量量化，困惑度和零样本准确率均优于强硬判决基线，并可与激活感知缩放、非相干处理等预处理叠加。
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a key technique for efficiently deploying large language models, as it compresses weights into low-bit representations without retraining. Existing PTQ solvers, including GPTQ, LDLQ, and block coordinate descent, commit each weight block to a single codeword before its neighbors are considered, leaving near-optimal alternatives unexplored. In this work, we cast row-wise PTQ as posterior inference over discrete codebooks, in which existing solvers correspond to a zero-temperature, hard-decision limit retaining only the top codeword per block. We propose Message-Passing Quantization (MPQ), which preserves soft posterior information across blocks during inference and commits to hard codewords only at the output stage. MPQ first uses vector approximate message passing to compute approximate blockwise posteriors, then refines a hard-decision initialization by exact block coordinate descent. Across 2-bit lattice and 3- and 4-bit scalar quantization on dense language models from Llama, Qwen, and Mistral families, MPQ improves perplexity and zero-shot accuracy over strong hard-decision baselines, and composes favorably with preprocessing techniques such as activation-aware scaling and incoherence processing. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/poseidonchan/MPQ.

papers.title_en: BiLoCo: Binary Low-Rank Corrections for Post-Training Quantization
papers.authors: David Jin, Beshr IslamBouli, Tarushii Goel, Han Guo, Yoon Kim
papers.evidence: 低秩修正与FP4训练后量化相结合
papers.tldr: FP4 训练后量化能大幅降低大模型推理成本，但直接量化仍有明显精度损失，SVDQuant 的高精度低秩修正又占用大量位数与张量核心算力。BiLoCo 把低秩修正的左右因子改为二进制 ±1 符号向量存储，每秩存储量减少 16 倍，修正退化为加减运算可跑在 CUDA 核心上。在 4B–72B 模型上精度匹配或超过同内存预算的 SVDQuant，B300 融合核在 batch=1、秩≤512 时最多慢 11%。
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) to FP4 has emerged as a key technique for reducing large language model inference cost, especially on Blackwell GPUs, which offer native FP4 tensor core support. Direct PTQ to FP4, however, still leaves a noticeable accuracy gap. Recent work on SVDQuant mitigates the errors introduced through FP4 quantization for diffusion models by adding high-precision low-rank corrections obtained via SVD. However, this high-precision low-rank correction requires many bits per rank, and it runs on the same tensor cores as the main FP4 GEMM. We introduce BiLoCo, a low-rank correction method whose left and right factors are stored as binary ${\{\pm 1\}}$ sign vectors rather than as BF16 numbers. The signed format uses $16{\times}$ less storage per rank-one component, and since the correction now consists of additions/subtractions, this can be run on CUDA cores concurrently with the FP4 tensor-core GEMM. On 4B--72B LLMs, BiLoCo matches or improves memory-matched SVDQuant for PTQ. We implement BiLoCo on B300 as a fused single kernel, where the FP4 GEMM runs on tensor cores, the bit-packed correction on the CUDA cores of the same launch, and the two are combined in the GEMM epilogue. With batch size $1$, the fused kernel is at most $11\%$ slower than the FP4-only GEMM for every rank up to $512$. At rank $128$, it is at most $20\%$ slower up to batch size $8$.

papers.title_en: AudioScorer: Learning Question-Aware Token Relevance for Large Audio Language Models
papers.evidence: 学习式问题感知token剪枝以压缩稠密多模态token序列
papers.tldr: 大型音频语言模型产生密集音频token，长音频处理成本高；现有剪枝多用注意力、相似度或时间采样，未显式按问题选token。AudioScorer用轻量模型根据用户问题给音频token打分，并以冻结LALM答案梯度显著性排序蒸馏和下游答案监督训练。10%保留率下，它在10项语义与声学任务中7项最佳或并列最佳，覆盖语音识别、情感识别和声景分类，显示问题感知剪枝可兼顾效率与效果。
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) reason over speech, environmental sounds, music, and other acoustic information. However, their audio encoders produce dense token sequences that make long-form audio costly to process. Existing audio pruning methods reduce this cost using heuristics such as attention, representation similarity, or temporal sampling, but do not explicitly learn which tokens are most useful for a given question. We propose AudioScorer, a lightweight model that scores audio tokens according to the user question. It is trained by distilling the ranking of audio tokens under the frozen LALM's answer-gradient saliency, together with downstream answer supervision. Compared with other pruning methods, AudioScorer achieves the best or tied-best result at 10% token retention on 7 of 10 semantic and acoustic tasks, including speech recognition, emotion recognition, and audio-scene classification.

papers.title_en: Video-MemComp: Taylor-Guided Sensitivity-Aware Memory Management for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.authors: Yonghui Niu, Yuhao Ji, Chang Nie, Jiao Zhang, Yilong Li, Junlan Feng, Ran He, Caifeng Shan, Chaoyou Fu
papers.evidence: 面向流式视频理解的敏感性感知视频上下文压缩
papers.tldr: 长视频流式理解受MLLM的KV缓存内存瓶颈制约，现有压缩方法还忽视近似误差累积。Video-MemComp以无需训练、敏感性感知的上下文管理框架，基于一阶泰勒展开将压缩误差分解为局部近似误差与层间结构敏感性。它在pre-RoPE安全区做token聚合并施加注意力保持的logit偏置，同时按离线梯度先验和在线上下文熵动态分配各层KV预算。在MLVU、VideoMME、EgoSchema上性能优于或媲美全缓存与先进压缩方法，Qwen2.5-VL-3B准确率由62.3%升至64.1%，KV内存节省超90%。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of video data has created an urgent need for efficient video understanding systems that can handle long and continuous visual inputs, posing significant challenges for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) due to severe memory bottlenecks. Moreover, existing compression methods often overlook the explosive accumulation of approximation errors. To address this issue, we propose Video-MemComp, a training-free and sensitivity-aware context management framework for memory-constrained streaming video understanding. Our method theoretically decomposes compression error into orthogonal local approximation error and layer-wise structural sensitivity via a first-order Taylor expansion. To minimize local approximation error, we perform token aggregation in a pre-RoPE safe zone with an attention-conserving logit bias, mitigating geometric distortions caused by RoPE rotations. To manage layer-wise structural sensitivity, we dynamically allocate the KV cache budget based on offline gradient priors and online context entropy, prioritizing high-sensitivity layers. Video-MemComp outperforms or achieves performance comparable to full-cache and state-of-the-art compression methods on benchmarks including MLVU, VideoMME, and EgoSchema. Notably, it improves the overall accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-3B from 62.3% to 64.1% while reducing the KV cache to an equivalent of 6,000 tokens per layer, saving over 90% of KV memory.
